about: Live Ops day plan (data only, read by js/liveops.js). Each event is a real NISAR pass date from cases/passes.json. An event only uses evidence cards whose availableOn date (in cases/<case>.json: the date of the last pass or other data the card uses) is on or before the event date. teachCard is the card that teaches teachTrap. keyNumbers are LABELS of entries in the case's numbers file; the values are read from that file at run time, never written here.
rules: every card in an event has availableOn <= the event date
the teach card shows the teach trap and is available on/before the event date
each event shows the teach card + 2-3 other cards, mixing real and trap where the case has both
days and the events inside them move forward in time
event dates are real NISAR pass dates (Jakarta: the end date of an interferogram pair)

waitEligible.jebel-ali/two-date: Change between just two NISAR images, 18 Jun and 28 Oct, with nothing removed.
